title: Royal Carillon School "Jef Denyn"
geometryBasis: Exact public-domain exterior already published on Qualla, cited historic protection record, native OSM footprint and Flemish 1-metre ground and roof surveys.
sectionBasis: The Flemish heritage inventory identifies a two-storey, five-bay corner house and clipped mansard. The exact Qualla view shows the blue stone corner portal, white facade, sash arrangement, dormer and terra-cotta roofs.
limitations: This model depicts the former school’s documented corner house at number 63. The modern institution’s premises on Bruul and the neighboring Hof van Busleyden palace are separate.
Small openings, signwork and roof details outside the exact photo view use bounded estimates.
